case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Workshop Flyer Missing Its Date
tests: Checks that the agent asks for the missing event date rather than guessing, omitting it or leaving a placeholder; the completed flyer is graded after the supplied answer.

checks.name: asks first (The date of the pottery workshop.)

got.question: What event date should appear on the flyer?

judge.summary: The flyer meets all requirements with accurate, legible text, a soft earthy palette, and a simple bowl illustration in a clean portrait layout.

must_haves.item: The completed flyer shows the user-confirmed date exactly as '24 July 2027', not a guessed date or placeholder.

must_haves.why: The headline reads 'Pottery Workshop' across two lines.

must_haves.item: The time and venue read exactly '14:00–16:00' and 'Clay House Studio'.
must_haves.why: Both the time and venue appear correctly and are clearly legible.

must_haves.item: The flyer includes exactly 'Beginners welcome' and no additional wording.
must_haves.why: The phrase appears correctly at the bottom, with no wording beyond the requested event details.

must_haves.item: The portrait 4:5 design uses soft earthy colours and a simple clay bowl illustration.
must_haves.why: The 4:5 portrait flyer uses a cream background and earthy terracotta text and bowl linework.

must_haves.item: All event details are legible and uncropped.
must_haves.why: All text is readable and comfortably contained within the flyer.
